rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; functional connectivity model trained on data from 40 scanning sites; surface area model from 66 sites. Sites include ABCD (21 sites), HCP-YA, HCP-Aging (4 sites), HCP-Development (4 sites), UK Biobank, Cam-CAN, PNC, NKI-RS, CMI-HBN, and others.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Functional normative models were trained on a large multi-site dataset (approx. N=22,000)" ; "Data from 40 sites were combined to create the initial full sample."
rci1_using_msad.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Methods / Normative model formulation, L110; Appendix 1 / Functional Brain Networks Normative Modeling, L460

rci2_using_epd.detail: Multiple established public datasets used for NM training including ABCD, Cam-CAN, HBN, HCP (YA/Aging/Development), NKI, PNC, UK Biobank, IXI, OASIS, and TOP.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Many sites were pulled from publicly available datasets including ABCD, CAMCAN, CMI-HBN, HCP-Aging, HCP-Development, HCP-Early Psychosis, HCP-Young Adult, NKI-RS, OpenNeuro, PNC, and UKBiobank."
rci2_using_epd.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Appendix 1 / Functional Brain Networks Normative Modeling, L460

rci3_epd_name.answer: ABCD; Cam-CAN; HBN; HCP; IXI; NKI; OASIS; PNC; TOP; UK Biobank
rci3_epd_name.detail: Functional model (Supp1) uses: ABCD (21 sub-sites), Cam-CAN, HBN (CMI-HBN_CBIC, CMI-HBN_RU), HCP (YA, Aging x4 sites, Development x4 sites), NKI-RS, PNC, UK Biobank. Surface area model (Supp2) additionally uses: IXI, OASIS (Oasis3), TOP. HCP-Early Psychosis sites in Supp2 include healthy controls only.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Many sites were pulled from publicly available datasets including ABCD, CAMCAN, CMI-HBN, HCP-Aging, HCP-Development, HCP-Early Psychosis, HCP-Young Adult, NKI-RS, OpenNeuro, PNC, and UKBiobank."

rci5_n.detail: model-1: Training phase HC from Supplementary file 1 (40 sites, 80/20 train-test split; total train+test approx. 21,594). model-2: Overall phase (no train/test split reported in Supplementary file 2; 66 sites). Structural cortical thickness models are pre-trained from Rutherford et al., 2022a (~58,000 subjects) and not extracted here.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Functional normative models were trained on a large multi-site dataset (approx. N=22,000)" ; "Training and testing datasets (80/20) were created using scikit-learn's train_test_split function, stratifying on the site variable." ; "We also share models of surface area, extracted in the same manner as the cortical thickness data from a similar dataset (described in Supplementary file 2)."
rci5_n.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Methods / Normative model formulation, L110; Appendix 1, L460; elife-85082-supp1-v2.xlsx.md; elife-85082-supp2-v2.xlsx.md

rci6_sex.detail: model-1: Training phase; female_n and male_n estimated from site-level sex percentages in Supplementary file 1 (rounding causes ±1 discrepancy). model-2: Overall phase; estimated from site-level sex percentages in Supplementary file 2.
rci6_sex.supporting_text: Supplementary file 1 reports per-site Sex (F/M)% for training set; Supplementary file 2 reports per-site Sex (F/M)% for surface area model. Individual-level sex counts not directly reported; computed from site-level N and percentages.

rci7_age.detail: model-1: Training phase; weighted mean and overall SD computed from 40 site-level statistics in Supplementary file 1 using law of total variance. Site mean ages range from 9.84 (ABCD) to 62.4 (UK Biobank). Age range not explicitly reported; structural models from Rutherford 2022a span ages 2-100 and the functional training sample 'closely resembles' the structural sample. model-2: Overall phase; computed from 66 sites in Supplementary file 2. Site mean ages range from 9.82 to 70.4. Age in years.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "The datasets used for training the functional models, the age range of the sample, and the procedures for evaluation closely resemble the structural normative models." ; "The sample size (approx. N=22,000) used for training and testing the functional models is smaller than the structural models (approx. N=58,000)" ; Supplementary file 1 and 2 provide per-site age (mean, s.d.).
